warmups.name: Glute Bridge Activation
warmups.precautions: Feet flat hip-width, knees tracking over toes;Ribs down - do not arch lower back at top;Chin slightly tucked, eyes forward (bridge/thrust)
warmups.cues: Feet flat, knees bent;Push through heels, ribs down;Squeeze glutes hard at the top

exercises.name: KB Swing (light)
exercises.precautions: Feet hip-width, soft bend in knees that stays;Flat back the whole time - spine long, chest up;Push hips BACK - weight slides close to legs;Stand by squeezing glutes - no leaning back at top
exercises.cues: Hinge at hips, not a squat;Snap hips, let the bell float;Keep back flat and core tight

exercises.name: Cable Glute Kickback
exercises.precautions: Feet flat hip-width, knees tracking over toes;Ribs down - do not arch lower back at top;Chin slightly tucked, eyes forward (bridge/thrust);Squeeze glutes hard at top for 1 second
exercises.cues: Hips still, core tight;Kick heel back, not up;Squeeze glute, lower slowly

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.precautions: Feet flat hip-width, knees tracking over toes;Ribs down - do not arch lower back at top;Chin slightly tucked, eyes forward (bridge/thrust);Squeeze glutes hard at top for 1 second
exercises.cues: Feet flat, knees bent;Push through heels, ribs down;Squeeze glutes hard at the top

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.precautions: Feet flat hip-width, knees tracking over toes;Ribs down - do not arch lower back at top;Chin slightly tucked, eyes forward (bridge/thrust);Squeeze glutes hard at top for 1 second
exercises.cues: Feet flat, knees bent;Push through heels, ribs down;Squeeze glutes hard at the top

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.precautions: Sit tall, back on pad - no leaning forward hard;Knees lined up with pads, feet flat on rests;Push from outer thighs/glutes - not by rocking torso;Move slowly - no slamming the weight stack
exercises.cues: Sit tall, pads outside knees;Press knees apart wide;Return slowly to stretch

exercises.name: KB Sumo Squat
exercises.precautions: Feet wider than shoulders, toes turned out ~45 degrees;Chest up, flat back - look straight ahead;Knees track out over toes - never cave in;Weight in heels and mid-foot - heels stay down
exercises.cues: Bell hangs between legs;Squat down wide and tall;Push through heels, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.precautions: On all fours - hands under shoulders, knees under hips;Back flat like a table - no sagging or twisting;Knee stays bent at 90 degrees the whole move;Hips stay square to floor - don't roll open
exercises.cues: Lift bent knee out to side;Keep hips level;Lower slowly, repeat, switch sides

stretches.name: Pigeon Pose
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
